name: Cinder
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Cinder
description:
Yeezy adds another colorway of its most popular design with the adidas Yeezy 350 Cinder, now available on StockX. This 350 V2 stays true to Yeezy’s signature palette, sporting dark earth tones that provide a natural feeling.

This Yeezy 350 V2 is composed of a cinder Primeknit upper with a tonal side stripe. A cinder Boost cushioned midsole sole and gold outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in March of 2020 and retailed for $220.

name: Dazzling Blue
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Dazzling Blue
description:
The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 Dazzling Blue is reminiscent of the 2016 Yeezy 350 V2 Black Friday Pack. Instead of featuring a marbled pattern and sheer side stripe, it opts for a solid black Primeknit upper and blue side stripe with "SPLY-350" text. At the base, a muted Boost sole offers comfort and support.

The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 Dazzling Blue released in February of 2022 and retailed for $220.

name: Beluga Reflective
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Beluga Reflective
description:
One of Yeezy's most celebrated designs received a reflective makeover with the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Beluga Reflective.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Beluga Reflective builds off of the original Beluga colorway by adding reflective qualities and speckled orange accents to its Primeknit upper. Signature details like a Boost sole and orange side stripe complete the design.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Beluga Reflective released in December of 2021 and retailed for $240.

name: Carbon
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Carbon
description:
Kanye West and adidas keep the ball rolling with the Yeezy 350 V2 Carbon. This release marks the 12th colorway of the favorite 350 V2 model in 2020 and this colorway’s dark-hued upper makes it the perfect piece of footwear for fall.

The Yeezy 350 V2 Carbon holds all of the familiar elements that make the silhouette so popular; breathable Primeknit solid black mesh with its signature side stripe, ribbed patterned off-white midsole, and classic BOOST cushioning make the 350 V2 Carbon easy to love and easy to wear.

The Yeezy 350 V2 Carbon released in October of 2020.

name: Onyx
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Onyx
description:
With a triple black Primeknit upper, the adidas Yeezy 350 V2 Onyx takes it back to the basics, using its muted palette to emphasize the intricacies of its construction. A sheer mesh side stripe and canvas heel loop offer a subtle contrast in texture. At the base, a matching signature Boost sole provides comfort and support.

The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 Onyx released in the Spring of 2022 and retailed for $220.

name: Light
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Light
description:
At a glance, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Light arrives in a clean triple white color palette, but when exposed to light, the white Primeknit upper changes to light pink and its mesh side stripe to dark yellow. An off-white Boost sole and canvas heel tab add the finishing touches.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Light released in August of 2021 and retailed for $220.

name: Carbon Beluga
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Carbon Beluga
description:
Just in time for summer adidas and Kanye West delivered the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Carbon Beluga, a revamped version of the classic Beluga colorway. The iconic partnership continues to defy expectations and redefine sneaker culture.

With the Carbon Beluga colorway, this drop showcased a fresh take on the beloved Beluga. The Primeknit upper wrapped around the Boost midsole is swathed in this cutting-edge colorway, infusing a familiar design with bold, modern energy. It screams street-ready while maintaining that sleek Yeezy aesthetic we all know and love. This is a sneaker that not only speaks to your style but also pushes it to new levels.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Carbon Beluga stomped onto the scene on May 31, 2023, with a retail price of $230.

name: Natural
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Natural
description:
Yeezy added a new colorway to their most popular line with the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Natural, now available on StockX.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Natural is reminiscent of the 350 V2 Cream that released in 2017. Its upper is mostly white, but instead of a monotone look, hits of light grey on the Primeknit upper give this design an identity of its own. A yellowed translucent Boost sole, a see-through side stripe, and traditional rope laces add the finishing touches to this most recent addition to the 350 V2 collection.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Natural released in October of 2020 and retailed for $200.

name: Zyon
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Zyon
description:
Yeezy adds another colorway of its most well-known design with the adidas Yeezy 350 Zyon, now available on StockX. This 350 V2 dons a similar pattern as the Static colorway, only this time ditching a white side stripe and grey accents for a darker brown stripe and mocha hues.

This Yeezy 350 V2 is composed of a Zyon Primeknit upper with a dark tonal side stripe. A translucent Boost cushioned sole and cream interior completes the design. These sneakers released in March of 2020 and retailed for $220.

name: Black Red (Infants)
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Black Red (Infants)
description:
The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Core Black Red 2017 I was part of the Yeezy and adidas collaborative collection.

The sneaker has an all-black colorway throughout the lace-up, and a black Primeknit upper with a stitched red SPLY-350 logo on the medial quarter panel and center seam. The crimson stitched pattern is also displayed on the pull tab at the heel. The structure is supported by a full-length boost midsole that is covered in semi-transparent chunky black rubber with a vertical linear pattern.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Core Black Red 2017 I debuted on February 11th, 2017 and retailed at $140.

name: Onyx
title: adidas Yeezy Slide Onyx
description:
First revealed in February 2022 at the Donda 2 listening event in Miami, the adidas Yeezy Slide Onyx features an all-black foam construction with a soft footbed for comfort. At the base, a grooved outsole adds stability and responsiveness.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Onyx released in March of 2022 and retailed for $60.

name: Resin
title: adidas Yeezy Slide Resin
description:
DISCLAIMER: US and UK sizing is the same and does not require any conversion.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Resin is made of Resin EVA foam throughout the design to provide lightweight durability. From there, a soft footbed offers an immediate step in comfort. An outsole with accentuated grooves for traction and support wraps the design.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Resin released in April of 2021 and retailed for $60.

name: Core
title: adidas Yeezy Slide Core
description:
DISCLAIMER: US and UK sizing is the same and does not require any conversion.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Core is composed of a Core EVA foam throughout the design to provide lightweight comfort. From there, a soft footbed offers cushioning. An outsole with accentuated grooves for traction and support completes the design.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Core released in April of 2021 and retailed for $60.

name: Pure (Restock Pair)
title: adidas Yeezy Slide Pure (Restock Pair)
description:
DISCLAIMER: US and UK sizing is the same and does not require any conversion.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Pure (Restock Pair) features a slightly different composition than the original adidas Yeezy Slide Pure that debuted in the spring of 2021. Instead of a smooth EVA foam construction, it has a pebbled, more textural touch. At the base, a grooved sole and cushioned footbed completes the design.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Pure (Restock Pair) released in December of 2021 and retailed for $60.

To shop the original adidas Yeezy Slide Pure, click here.

name: Ochre
title: adidas Yeezy Slide Ochre
description:
The adidas Yeezy Slide Ochre is constructed entirely of EVA foam in a monochromatic fashion. A soft footbed offers immediate step-in comfort for daily wear. From there, deep groove treads on the sole provide traction and support.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Ochre released in December of 2021 and retailed for $60.

name: Clay Brown
title: adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Clay Brown
description:
Yeezy returned to the Earth-toned palette with the Yeezy 700 V3 Clay Brown. The Clay Brown slightly resembles the Alvah with its primarily black look. But instead of a completely muted upper, it dons lighter earth tones, adding contrast throughout the silhouette.

The Yeezy 700 V3 Clay Brown features a black engineered mesh upper with light brown streaks running along the side encompassed by a signature translucent cage unit. A thick EVA foam midsole, reinforced toe cap, and 3M detailing on the forefoot complete this futuristic look.

The Yeezy 700 V3 Clay Brown released in December of 2020 and retailed for $200.

name: Wave Runner
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Wave Runner
description:
The Yeezy 700 Boost Wave Runner is the shoe that led Yeezy's pivot from a sleek, minimal aesthetic to a chunky, 90s inspired one. This was the gateway sneaker between knit runners like the 350 and the grungy skate look of the 550. The Yeezy 700 Wave Runner features a grey mesh and leather upper with black suede overlays and teal mesh underlays. At the base, a thick Boost sole and contrasting hits of orange complete the design.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 Wave Runner originally released in November of 2017, and most recently re-released in March of 2022 for a retail price of $300.

name: Bone
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Bone
description:
Yeezy added a new colorway to their 700 MNVN series with the adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Bone, now available on StockX. Although the silhouette dons a familiar Boost 700 sole, this shoe differs by displaying "700" branding on the upper using compact materials. 

This Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN is comprised of a Bone nylon upper paired with reflective detailing. A solid black sole with Boost cushioning completes the design. These sneakers released in April of 2020 and retailed for $220.

name: Tephra
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 V2 Tephra
description: If you’re looking for a tough sneaker then you need to buy the new adidas Yeezy Boost 700 V2 Tephra. This Yeezy Boost 700 V2 comes with a tephra upper, tephra midsole, and a tephra sole. These sneakers released in June 2019 and retailed for $300. Place a Bid for these Yeezys today on StockX.

name: Dark Glow
title: adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Dark Glow
description:
Disclaimer: Wear with caution. Midsole may crack or crumble over time.

The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Dark Glow features a black Primeknit upper with a black TPU cage that glows vivid blue when exposed to the dark. From there, an EVA foam sole adds support for a cushioned fit.

The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Dark Glow released in August of 2021 and retailed for $200.

name: Arzareth
title: adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Arzareth
description:
The Yeezy 700 V3 Arzareth features a blue and grey Primeknit upper that is complemented by a traditional translucent glow-in-the-dark cage overlay. From there, an EVA foam midsole, grey toe cap, and black lining complete the design.

The Yeezy 700 V3 Arzareth released in August of 2020 and retailed for $200.

name: MX Cinder
title: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR MX Cinder
description:
The adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MX Cinder is where high fashion meets innovative comfort. Wrapped in a MX Cinder colorway, this pair offers a unique combination of dark, earthy hues, giving it a versatile appeal that's equal parts streetwear-ready and avant-garde.

Constructed with a unique foam compound, the Yeezy Foam RNNR conforms to your foot for unparalleled comfort, while its distinctive, porous design gives off an out-of-this-world vibe. This sneaker pushes the boundaries of traditional footwear aesthetics and function, making it a must-have for trendsetters.With a fashion-forward design, the adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MX Cinder not only elevates your style but promises ultimate comfort in every step. Take your sneaker game into the future.

The adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MX Cinder released on May 31, 2023, with a retail price of $90.

name: MXT Moon Gray
title: adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MXT Moon Gray
description:
DISCLAIMER: US and UK sizing is the same and does not require any conversion.

The Yeezy Foam RNNR MXT Moon Grey delivers a new color layout, making it different from the original, neutral Ararat. Constructed partially from algae, the entire shoe is hit with a mix of Sand and Moon Grey colors in a psychedelic mashup.

The Yeezy Foam RNNR MXT Moon Grey released in March of 2021 for $80.

name: MX Sand Grey (Kids)
title: adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MX Sand Grey (Kids)
description:
The adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MX Sand Grey (Kids) feature injected EVA foam and part-harvested algae for a lightweight build on the slip-on. The silhouette is dressed in a swirl of earth-toned colors for this iteration.

The flexible Yeezy slides flaunt ventilation ports on the sides as well as the vamp on the forefoot. Coral accents decorate the MX Sand Grey colorway on the silhouette. Underfoot is a wavy pattern with treads like on the Stone Sage hpr. The threads deliver traction across various surfaces, while the ports are designed for breathability around your foot. A soft top layer on the foot bed further aids in the slip-ons' comfort proposition.

What our experts like about the Yeezy Foam Sand Greys is their resulting colorway, which has earthy tones with playful coral and pink accents, ideal for kids. The adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MX Sand Grey (Kids) was released on December 11, 2021, retailing for $60.

name: Onyx
title: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR Onyx
description:
The adidas Yeezy Foam RNR Onyx arrives with an Onyx, oval-cut foam construction made of part EVA and algae. At the base, a cushioned footbed offers comfort and support, while a sculptural sole with deep treads provides traction.

The adidas Yeezy Foam RNR Onyx released in June of 2022 and retailed for $80 and in March of 2024 and retailed for $90.

name: Taupe Blue
title: adidas Yeezy Desert Boot Taupe Blue
description:
After nearly a year and a half hiatus, Yeezy brought back the Desert Boot silhouette in 2021 with the adidas Yeezy Desert Boot Taupe Blue. The Taupe Blue separates itself from previous Yeezy Desert Boots by presenting a design with strong contrast in its elements.

While previous Desert Boot releases have primarily featured colorways of subtle earth tones, the Taupe Blue taps into a more saturated palette. It features a tonal-brown upper that is composed of a mix of suede, nubuck, and mesh. From there, a solid Taupe Blue mudguard and sole seamlessly grip the upper to provide a sturdy base for traction and support. Olive rope laces add the finishing touches to this utilitarian design.

The adidas Yeezy Desert Boot Taupe Blue released in March of 2021 and retailed for $200.

name: Slate
title: adidas Yeezy 500 High Slate
description:
Yeezy enlists a new variation of a popular design with the adidas Yeezy 500 Slate High, now available on StockX. This is the first high-top sneaker silhouette Yeezy has released since the 750. Similar to the 500 Stone release, Yeezy replaces mesh with neoprene to add a sleek look to this high-top model.

This Yeezy 500 High is composed of a Slate neoprene and suede with reflective piping. A matching Adiprene midsole and gum rubber outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in December of 2019 and retailed for $200.

name: Cloud White
title: adidas Yeezy 450 Cloud White
description:
In early 2020, images of the adidas Yeezy 450 began to circulate when Kanye was spotted outside of the Yeezy Season 8 fashion show during Paris Fashion Week. This otherworldly design captured the attention of Yeezy fans, mostly because it is unlike anything Yeezy has ever made. Then, one year later, Yeezy finally released its brand new 450 silhouette with the adidas Yeezy 450 Cloud White.

The adidas Yeezy 450 Cloud White is one of Yeezy’s most unique designs yet. Its simplified two-piece construction appears complex due to its extreme, molded foam sole. The sole clasps the mesh upper, acting as an exoskeleton to provide structure. Similar to the Yeezy 700 V3, this release does not feature Boost or adiPRENE technology. Instead, Yeezy utilizes EVA foam to deliver comfort.

The adidas Yeezy 450 Cloud White released in March of 2021 and retailed for $200.

name: Mono Ice
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Mono Ice
description:
The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 Mono Ice is one of three from the Mono pack. Each sneaker’s upper is constructed from a new monofilament mesh in Ice blue that exposes the model’s inner cage lining. The Mono pack brings back the heel’s pull tab design on each pair. To finish it out, a familiar Boost sole is added for comfort for the wearer.

The adidas Yeezy 350 V2 Mono Ice released in June of 2021 for $220, exclusively in the US.

name: Israfil
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Israfil
description:
Yeezy added to their already extensive catalog with the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Israfil, now available on StockX.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Israfil features the same elements that fans of the sneaker love. The upper features multi-colored threads that add a variety of looks to the wearer’s feet from different angles. From there, the upper is matched with a translucent midsole that showcases the sneaker’s BOOST cushioned tech.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Israfil released in August of 2020 for $220.

name: Bone
title: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Bone
description:
The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Bone features a triple white Primeknit upper with mesh side stripes and canvas heel tabs. At the base, a semi-translucent sole with Boost technology completes the design.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Bone released in March of 2022 and retailed for $230.

name: Marina Blue (Women's)
title: Jordan 1 Low Marina Blue (Women's)
description:
The women's Jordan 1 Low Marina Blue (W) arrives with a smooth white leather upper with Marina Blue overlays and Swooshes. At the heel, an embroidered Jordan Wings logo tributes the collar on the original Air Jordan 1. From there, a white and Marina Blue Air sole adds the finishing touch.

The women's Jordan 1 Low Marina Blue (W) released in January of 2022 and retailed for $100.

name: Raging Bull Red (2021) (GS)
title: Jordan 5 Retro Raging Bull Red (2021) (GS)
description:
The Air Jordan 5 Retro Raging Bulls Red 2021 GS features a Varsity Red suede upper with quarter panel netting on the side wall. A red-on-red embroidered number 23, black leather molded eyelets, red laces, and a silver tongue edged with black complete the look. The outer sole is gray, black, and white. The midsole is black with jagged splashes of white and red and visible air cushioning. Iconic Jumpman logos appear on the tongue, heel, and outer sole.

This grade-school-sized Air Jordan 5 Retro Raging Bulls Red 2021 GS was released on April 10, 2021 at a retail price of $140.

name: Dark Marina Blue
title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Dark Marina Blue
description:
The Air Jordan 1 High Dark Marina Blue arrives with a smooth black leather upper with Dark Marina Blue overlays and Swooshes. On the ankle wrap, a black Jordan Wings logo pays homage to the origins of the Air Jordan 1. From there, a contrasting white and blue Air sole completes the design.

The Air Jordan 1 High Dark Marina Blue releases in February of 2022 and retails for $170.

name: Hyper Royal Smoke Grey (GS)
title: Jordan 1 Retro High Hyper Royal Smoke Grey (GS)
description:
The children’s (Grade-School sizing) Air Jordan 1 Retro High Hyper Royal Smoke Grey GS uses a Hyper Royal/Light Smoke Grey/White colorway. The white leather upper features a Light Smoke Grey Swoosh and gray leather collar accents. Blue distressed suede overlays give the shoe a vintage feel. The Nike Air logo and Swoosh appear on a blue patch on the white tongue, and also on the white insole. A white "Wings" icon enhances the suede on the collar. The midsole is white with an Air unit, and the outsole is gray.

The Air Jordan 1 Retro High Hyper Royal Smoke Grey GS was released on April 17, 2021, and retailed for $130.

name: UNC White
title: Jordan 6 Retro UNC White
description:
Jordan Brand drew inspiration from Michael Jordan's alma mater, the University of North Carolina, for the Air Jordan 6 Retro UNC White.

Constructed with University Blue Durabuck and white leather, the Air Jordan 6 Retro UNC White utilizes color blocking reminiscent of the renowned Jordan 6 Carmine. Hits of navy blue on the tongue and midsole integrate UNC's lesser known school color. At the heel, a Jordan Team patch nod to the jock tags that are stitched to the bottom of UNC's uniforms. From there, an icy semi-translucent Air sole completes the design.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro UNC White released in March of 2022 and retailed for $210.

name: Lucky Green (Women's)
title: Jordan 1 Retro High Lucky Green (Women's)
description:
The Jordan 1 Lucky Green takes inspiration from Michael Jordan’s 63-point game against the Boston Celtics in 1986. Although its purpose is to draw attention towards MJ’s iconic scoring performance, the sneakers are known colloquially as the Heineken for its resemblance to the 2003 Nike SB Dunk Low. A mix of Lucky Green, white, and black tumbled leathers are featured on the upper. Hits of red come through on the wings logo, heel, and tongue tab.

The women's Air Jordan 1 Lucky Green released October of 2020 and retailed for $170.

name: White Shadow (GS)
title: Jordan 1 Mid White Shadow (GS)
description:
The Kids Air Jordan 1 Mid White Shadow pays homage to the Jordan 1 High Shadow, which originally released in 1985. While the design sticks with foundational black and Shadow grey panels, it adds white into the mix to provide a new take on the classic.

The Kids Air Jordan 1 Mid White Shadow has a neutral-based colorway of white, grey and black. These shoes are constructed of a sturdy leather that encompasses the forefoot, toe cap, and mid-panel. White leather overlays are located on the heel, collar, and middle eyelet panel. An Air sole unit in the heel and a padded mid-top collar completes the design.

The Kids Air Jordan Mid White Shadow was released in October of 2020 and retailed for $90.

name: White (Women's)
title: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 White (Women's)
description:
The women's Nike Air Force 1 Low White silhouette (W) continues the tradition of the 1982 Air Force 1. The sneaker features an all-white leather upper with a perforated toe box and Swoosh overlays. A Nike heel embroidery and white sole completes the design.

The women's Nike Air Force 1 Low White 2018 (W) released in January 2018 and retailed for $90. The retail price was increased to $115 in 2023.

name: Jubilee 25th Anniversary
title: Jordan 11 Retro Jubilee 25th Anniversary
description:
In 2020, Jordan Brand celebrated 25 years of one of their most popular models, the Jordan 11. To commemorate the famed silhouette, Michael Jordan and Nike released the Jordan 11 Jubilee. The sneaker’s distinct colorway was inspired by original sketches from the designer of the 1995 sneaker, Tinker Hatfield.

The Jordan 11 Jubilee showcases everything Hatfield envisioned for the sneaker 25 years ago; a performance product that can be worn easily both on and off the court. Features such as the two types of leather on the upper with hits of metallic lettering and Jumpman emblem add luxe elements to the athletic sneaker. A white midsole and foggy translucent outsole deliver contrast to the black sneaker. Carbon fiber plating on the sole provides stability and power to the wearer’s feet on the court.

The Jordan 11 Jubilee 25th Anniversary released in December of 2020 for $220.

name: Undefeated Militia Green (2020)
title: Nike Air Max 97 Undefeated Militia Green (2020)
description:
The UNDFTD X Nike Air collaboration brings back a coveted flight jacket-inspired colorway originally in this Nike Air Max 97 Undefeated Militia Green (2020). The Los Angeles retailer’s take on the Nike Air Max 97 Undefeated Militia Green (2020) features olive green coloring throughout the mesh and leather upper, accented with a repeating string of Undefeated logos printed on the lowermost of the sneaker’s wavy overlays. Touches of Orange Blaze are noticeable on the outsole, tongue patch and anterior pull tab, and underfoot, full-length Max Air provides cushioning.

The Nike Air Max 97 Undefeated Militia Green (2020) was released in December 2020 and retailed for $180.

name: Silver Toe (Women's)
title: Jordan 1 Retro High Silver Toe (Women's)
description:
Jordan Brand continued its "Black Toe" theme with the Air Jordan 1 Silver Toe (W). Arriving in women’s sizing, the Silver Toe added a new look to Jordan’s ever-growing women’s collection.

The women's Jordan 1 Silver Toe (W) is a spinoff of the 2018 Jordan 1 High Gold Toe, replacing metallic gold patent leather construction with metallic silver crinkled leather. White and black leather comprise the mid-panel, toe guard, and Swoosh as a nod to other classic Black Toe designs. Nike Air branding on the tongue, an Air Jordan Wings logo on the ankle, and a white/black sole complete the design.

The women's Air Jordan 1 Silver Toe (W) released in February of 2021 and retailed for $170.

name: A Ma Maniére Dusk
title: Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniére Dusk
description:
The Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniére Dusk takes center stage in a collaboration between A Ma Maniére and the Air Jordan Brand. It is part of a dynamic two-sneaker pack and is dressed in black and burgundy crush with additional black and pale ivory accents.

This high-top silhouette features a black suede upper. Pale-ivory mesh netting made out of A Ma Maniére’s distinctive ‘A’ logo is found on the quarter and part of the tongue. The sleek design is complemented by black-on-black ‘Nike Air’ embroidery on the heel and a silver reflective tongue that displays black Jumpman branding. The black polyurethane midsole, embellished with shark-tooth detailing in a deep burgundy hue, provides a striking contrast, while the pre-aged translucent rubber outsole gives it some added flair. Black laces can be held tightly in place with a translucent Nike-branded lace lock.

A standout feature is the visible Air pack in the heel that sports A Ma Maniére branding on the lateral side of the shoe. The Jordan 5 Retro A Ma Maniére Dusk sneaker sold for $225 during its retail debut on November 24, 2023.

name: Hare
title: Jordan 6 Retro Hare
description:
Jordan Brand paid homage to an old ad campaign classic by releasing the Jordan 6 Retro Hare, now available on StockX. The Hare colorway originally made its debut on an Air Jordan 7 in one of the first Jordan ads that featured Bugs Bunny. Jumpman keeps the tradition alive by transferring this iconic colorway to a new silhouette.

This Jordan 6 consists of a white leather upper with grey underlays and a red detailing. A translucent tongue, patterned outsole, and a purple Jumpman on the heel complete the design.
These sneakers released in April of 2020 and retailed for $190.

name: St Patrick's Day (2021)
title: Nike Air Max 90 St Patrick's Day (2021)
description:
The Nike Air Max 90 St Patrick's Day 2021 was designed by Tinker Hatfield and has a palette of two shades of green.

The upper part of this Air Max 90 is constructed from breathable white mesh with leather overlays in pine green, that include the shamrock-embossed mudguard. The sneaker has anterior eyelets with green accents, a polyurethane midsole, a Nike-branded heel patch and features the signature Air sole cushioning under the heel. The side of the shoe has the Nike Swoosh in white and the Air Max logo in translucent.

The Nike Air Max 90 St Patrick's Day 2021 was released on March 12th, 2021, with its retail price at $140.

name: Alternate Bel-Air
title: Jordan 5 Retro Alternate Bel-Air
description:
Jumpman paid tribute to Will Smith’s electrifying 90s outfits in The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air with the Jordan 5 Alternate Bel-Air, now available on StockX. Drawing inspiration from the 2013 Jordan 5 Bel-Air, the Alternate Bel-Air arrives with a brighter take on Smith’s favorite Jordans.

Also known as the Jordan 5 Poison Green, the Alternate Bel-Air consists of the same 90s style colors and patterns as its predecessor, only this time the grey upper is replaced with white leather. A multi-color midsole, icy translucent outsole, and mismatched green and pink Jumpman logos on the tongues complete this retro-style masterpiece. These sneakers released in August of 2020 and retailed for $200.

name: Bad Bunny Last Forum
title: adidas Forum Buckle Low Bad Bunny Last Forum
description:
The adidas Forum Buckle Low White is a collaborative sneaker between the German lifestyle brand and artist Bad Bunny.

The shoe has an off-white leather upper with matching suede overlays, and the signature 3-Stripes are made of grey suede. An adjustable ankle strap and toggle lacing that wraps around the collar is added to the laces for a secure fit. The "third eye" logo of Bad Bunny is displayed on two sets of overlapping tongues. The shoe has clear rubber sidewalls on a rubber cup sole.

The adidas Forum Buckle Low White debuted on the market on December 10th, 2022, retailing at $160.

name: Bape 30th Anniversary Green Camo
title: adidas Forum 84 Low Bape 30th Anniversary Green Camo
description:
The adidas Forum 84 Low Bape 30th Anniversary Green Camo presents an intriguing collaboration between the tried and true basketball silhouette and the Japanese streetwear and lifestyle fashion brand that opened its first store in 1993.

The Bape 30th Anniversary Edition of the adidas Forum 84 in a Green Camo colorway sports a leather upper with a grainy texture and the classic Bape camo pattern. True to the Forum silhouette, a hook and loop strap secures the top of the laces and the toe box is perforated for enhanced ventilation. The EVA midsole along with the chunky rubber outsole provide cushioning, support, and bounce for the basketball court or the city streets.

What we love most about this sneaker are all the hits of dual branding, including the Bathing Ape icon nestled in the lateral side camo on the quarter panel, just behind the cut-out window featuring the iconic adidas three stripes. The adidas Forum 84 Low Bape 30th Anniversary Green Camo was released on May 20, 2023 for a retail price of $180.

name: Travis Scott British Khaki (PS)
title: Jordan 6 Retro Travis Scott British Khaki (PS)
description:
The Air Jordan 6 Retro Travis Scott British Khaki (PS) is a collaboration between the Jordan Brand and Travis Scott, specifically designed for preschool aged children.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro Travis Scott British Khaki PS features an upper crafted with suede and canvas, accented with Bright Crimson details. The stash pouch makes a repeat appearance on the lateral collar, while new zippered detailing is added to the medial side. Mismatched Nike Air and Cactus Jack branding adorns the heel of the left and right shoe, with additional graphics on the outsole, midsole, tongue, and lace lock.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro Travis Scott British Khaki (PS) was released on April 30, 2021 at a retail price of $80.

name: Travis Scott British Khaki
title: Jordan 6 Retro Travis Scott British Khaki
description:
Travis Scott and Jordan Brand teamed up to deliver the Air Jordan 6 Retro Travis Scott British Khaki. The British Khaki marks the second time that Travis has added his touch to the Jordan 6 silhouette, the first being the 2019 Air Jordan 6 Travis Scott.

The upper of the Air Jordan 6 Retro Travis Scott British Khaki is made of British Khaki suede. From there, hits of Bright Crimson appear on the heel and tongue embroidered logos. The upper also has two cargo pockets: one with a snap enclosure on the lateral ankle and one with a zip enclosure on the medial ankle. A translucent tongue, heel tab, and outsole that glows in the dark adds the finishing touches to this latest Travis Scott Jordan.

The Air Jordan 6 Retro Travis Scott British Khaki released in April of 2021 and retailed for $250.

name: Red Black Toe
title: Jordan 1 Mid SE Red Black Toe
description:
Jordan Brand offers a reconstructed look at the Jordan 1 Mid with the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Union Black Toe. The design resembles the Air Jordan 1 Union LA Black Toe that was released in 2018.

The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Union Black Toe is constructed of white leather with light grey suede overlays. The white leather makes up the toe, collar and mid-panel. Details include zigzagged stitching on the liner and a red Wings logo on the ankle. A white midsole and black outsole completes the design.

The Air Jordan Mid SE Union Black Toe released in August of 2020 and retailed for $120.

name: Patent Bred
title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Patent Bred
description:
The Air Jordan 1 High Bred Patent features black and red patent leather upper with signature weaved Nike Air tongue labels. From there, a classic Wings logo on the collar and a white with red Air sole complete the retro design.

The Air Jordan 1 High Bred Patent releases in December of 2021 and retails for $170.

To shop all Air Jordan 1 shoes, click here.

name: Viotech (2020)
title: Nike Air Trainer 3 Viotech (2020)
description:
The Viotech, Dandelion, Viola, and Grey Slate Nike Air Trainer 3 Viotech 2020 is one of Nike’s Air Trainer 3 brands of sneakers on the market.

The Nike Air Trainer 3 Viotech 2020 features a perforated toe-box to optimize airflow, a white rubber midsole for cushioning impact absorption, a visible Air unit in the white midsole for cushioning and comfort, and a black treaded outsole for traction and gripping. Its predominantly viola-colored upper is contrasted with Dandelion accents on the side Swoosh.

The Nike Air Trainer 3 Viotech 2020 was launched on June 1, 2020 with a retail price of $130.

name: Light Smoke Grey
title: Jordan 1 Retro High Light Smoke Grey
description:
Jordan delivered another new colorway of their most popular silhouette with the Jordan 1 Retro High Light Smoke Grey, now available on StockX. Following a similar reconstructed design language as the Jordan 1 Union LA from 2018, this Jordan 1 utilizes color blocking and different materials to present familiar colors in a unique format.

The Jordan 1 High Light Smoke Grey is composed of a white leather upper with grey suede overlays and a red leather ankle panel. Black suede on the heel paneling and Swoosh, a white midsole, and black outsole completes the design. This Jordan 1 released in July of 2020 and retailed for $170 USD.

name: White Oreo (2021) (GS)
title: Jordan 4 Retro White Oreo (2021) (GS)
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro White Oreo 2021 (GS) features white, tech grey, black, and fire red colors with a webbed canvas upper that combines with leather components at the toe cap and along the sides. From there, Tech Grey shading accents the rest of the upper, and speckling along the tongue, ankle, and midsole rounds out the look.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro White Oreo 2021 (GS) released in July of 2021 and retailed for $150.

name: White Oreo (2021)
title: Jordan 4 Retro White Oreo (2021)
description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro White Oreo features a white leather and mesh upper with hits of Tech Grey on its eyelets and midsole. From there, a red Jumpman logo is embroidered on the tongue, adding a pop of color to the neutral-toned design.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro White Oreo released on Saturday, July 3rd and retailed for $190.

name: Carmine (2021)
title: Jordan 6 Retro Carmine (2021)
description:
The Air Jordan 6 Carmine returned in its original form in 2021. The nearly 20-year-old colorway first made its appearance in 1991 during Michael Jordan’s ’91-’92 season and brought in a new form of color blocking to the signature silhouette.

The Air Jordan 6 Carmine combines red, white, and black colors to represent the Chicago Bulls’ signature colors. The upper features bold red and white colors that help the model pop while on foot. From there, the upper is met with a white and black midsole, with hits of an icy blue outsole appear as well. The final touch to this OG’s return is the signature "Nike Air" on the heel, replacing 2008 and 2012 retros’ "Jumpman" logo.

The Air Jordan 6 Carmine released in February of 2021 for $200.

name: Black Skeleton Halloween (2019)
title: Nike Air Force 1 Low Black Skeleton Halloween (2019)
description:
Nike continues their 2019 Halloween rollout with the Nike Air Force 1 Low Black Skeleton, now available on StockX. This is the second installment in Nike’s Skeleton Force series, the first releasing in October of 2018 in a white and grey colorway.

This Air Force 1 features an X-Ray like foot scan on either side of the black leather upper. White detailing, a black midsole, and translucent outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in October of 2019 and retailed for $130.

name: UNC (2021)
title: Nike Dunk Low UNC (2021)
description:
Nodding to the University of North Carolina Tarheels, the Nike Dunk Low UNC is constructed of a white leather upper with University Blue overlays and Swooshes. From there, a white and University woven Nike tongue label completes the design.

The Nike Dunk Low UNC released in June of 2021 and retailed for $100.

name: University Blue
title: Jordan 4 Retro University Blue
description:
Jordan Brand paid homage to MJ’s alma mater with the Air Jordan 4 University Blue. The University Blue colorway draws a close resemblance to the extremely rare Air Jordan 4 UNC PE that was given to Tarheel student-athletes in 2019.

The Air Jordan 4 University Blue features a University Blue suede upper with mesh netting on the quarter panel and tongue. Similar to OG Jordan 4 colorways of the past, the eyelets, heel tab, and sections of the midsole are a speckled Cement Grey. Hits of black appear on the wing eyelets, sole, and Jumpman logo on the heel tab. Two woven labels are stitched to the tongue; one being the classic Jumpman woven label; the other being a Team Jordan jock tag. A black, white, and Tech Grey sole with a clear Air unit completes the design.

The Air Jordan 4 University Blue released in April of 2021 and retailed for $200.

name: sacai Iron Grey
title: Nike Blazer Low sacai Iron Grey
description:
The Nike Blazer Low sacai Iron Grey displays design themes that are prevalent in Nike and Sacai's collaborative history together. An Iron Grey and white leather upper provides a neutral look, allowing its layered construction to rise to prominence. From there, doubled Swooshes, tongues, and eyestays add a reconstructed feel to the classic design.

The Nike Blazer Low sacai Iron Grey released in July of 2021 and retailed for $120.

name: Lightning (2021)
title: Jordan 4 Retro Lightning (2021)
description:
Originally released in 2006, the Air Jordan 4 Retro Lightning (2021) is one of the most renowned retro Jordan 4 colorways in Jordan Brand's catalog. It features a Tour Yellow Durabuck upper with black netted panels and dark grey eyelets. On the tongue, a black Jordan Flight logo patch with white and yellow accents complements the upper. From there, a Jumpman logo on the heel tab and white midsole with a visible Air unit completes the design.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro Lightning (2021) released in August of 2021 and retailed for $220.

name: Low CLOT Terra Blush
title: Jordan 14 Retro Low CLOT Terra Blush
description:
Chinese brand CLOT continues its partnership with Nike and Jordan Brand with this Jordan 14 Low. This marks their fifth collab on a Jordan model, as CLOT uses Jordan Retro silhouettes as a canvas to share stories of Chinese culture and history.

The Air Jordan 14 CLOT design is inspired by The Terracotta Army, clay warrior statues that protected China’s Emperor at his burial in 213 B.C. The sneaker takes cues from the warriors’ color scheme, adding earthy tones to every part of the silhouette. The upper mimics the amour featured on each statue. Lastly, the heel features a red-stitched medallion, adding to its historic theme.

The Air Jordan 14 CLOT released in February of 2021 for $200.

name: Media Day
title: Nike LeBron 7 Media Day
description:
Nike Basketball mixed up one of the most popular Lebron silhouettes to date with the Nike Lebron 7 Media Day, now available on StockX. Lebron James originally debuted this colorway during the Lakers’ Media Day in 2019.

This Lebron 7 is comprised of a Lakers’ color scheme. One shoe features a purple Flywire upper with yellow detailing and the other features a yellow Flywire upper with purple detailing. Both shoes come with white leather overlays and a Nike Swoosh. White Flywire detailing, Lebron branding on the heel, and a purple and yellow outsole completes the design. These sneakers released in May of 2020 and retailed for $200 USD.

name: Supernova (2020)
title: Nike Air Max 90 Supernova (2020)
description:
The Nike Air Max 90 Supernova (2020) features a black, white, and multicolored leather and textile uppers, with the soft underlays sporting a galaxy-like print that includes bursts of blue, black, red, pink, and white. From there, Nike branding on the tongue and an exposed "Air Max" sole complete the design.

The Nike Air Max 90 Supernova (2020) released in June of 2020 and retailed for $120.

name: Bred Toe
title: Jordan 1 Mid Bred Toe
description:
The Jordan 1 Mid Bred Toe features a black, white, and Noble Red leather upper, with the "Bred Toe" name coming from the Noble Red palette found on the perforated leather toe. From there, Noble Red accents the "Jumpman" and "Air Jordan" Nike logos, red Nike "Swoosh" swoops back toward the black heel panel, and another touch of Noble Red at the outsole complete the design.

The Jordan 1 Mid Bred Toe released in January 2020 and retailed for $110.

name: Iowa (2020) (PS)
title: Nike Dunk High Iowa (2020) (PS)
description:
Dressed in Black/Varsity Maize, the Nike Dunk High Iowa (2020) (PS) is a high-top sneaker from the Nike Dunk collection in preschool sizing.

This sneaker features an all-leather construction on the upper with a black base on the toebox, quarter panels, and ankle collar. This is highlighted by Varsity Maize overlays on the forefoot, eyestays, Swooshes, and heels. More yellow accents appear on the lining, flat laces, pull tab, insole, and tongue tag branding. Other details include toebox perforations and a black tongue. A white midsole on a Varsity Maize rubber outsole finishes off the design.

What our experts love about this preschool Dunk High is its build and unique colorway. The color combination gives the shoe a bold and eye-catching look, while the premium materials used in its construction provide a high-quality look and feel. The Nike Dunk High Iowa (2020) (PS) was made available on December 9th, 2020, for a retail price of $85.

name: Bad Bunny Benito
title: adidas Forum Powerphase Bad Bunny Benito
description:
The adidas Forum Powerphase Bad Bunny Benito ditches the traditional Forum ankle strap and borrows paneling from the classic adidas Powerphase silhouette. The upper is constructed of canvas and leather, with brown, black, and pastel hues prominent in the color blocking. Triple-stacked heel padding, a yellowed sole, and customized "Benito" text on the lateral side complete the design.

The adidas Forum Powerphase Bad Bunny Benito released in February of 2022 and retailed for $160.

name: Off-White Sail (PS)
title: Jordan 5 Retro Off-White Sail (PS)
description:
The Air Jordan 5 Retro Off White Sail PS, made in collaboration with late designer Virgil Abloh, features an upper with semi translucent textile finished in a Sail colorway.

The tongue of this Air Jordan 5 for pree-schoolers sports a reflective silver finish, with cutouts on the left tongue matched by the mid-foot and collar. A zip-tie and lines of Helvetica text on the medial side are added to Abloh´s details, while underfoot, the midsole´s AIR units give way to a yellow translucent rubber outsole.

The Air Jordan 5 Retro Off White Sail PS was released on October 29th 2020, at a retail price of $225.

name: Military Black
title: Jordan 4 Retro Military Black
description:
Jordan Brand flipped one of its original Air Jordan 4 colorways for the Air Jordan 4 Military Black.

Pulling its color-blocked style from the Air Jordan 4 Military Blue, the Air Jordan 4 Military Black features a smooth white leather upper with a light grey Durabuck toe wrap and netted TPU inserts. Military Black eyelets, heel tabs, and underlays add a stark contrast to the upper. At the base, a white, black, and light grey sole with a visible Air unit completes the design.

The Air Jordan 4 Military Black released in May of 2022 and retailed for $210.

name: Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse
title: Jordan 1 Retro High OG Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse
description:
Nike and Jordan Brand are returning back to the Spider-Verse for their second Spider-Man themed Air Jordan 1, with the release of the Air Jordan 1 High OG Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse.

Also known as the Next Chapter, the Jordan 1 High OG Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse is the next iteration of the original Air Jordan 1 Chicago colorway. The limited edition sneakers are constructed using various leathers, suedes, and other premium materials across the uppers. The patterns used across the sneakers are designed to mimic the Miles Morales/Spider-Man animation style.

The Air Jordan 1 High OG Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse released May 20, 2023, with a retail price of $200.

name: Craft Photon Dust
title: Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Photon Dust
description:
After releasing previously in Nikes Dunk, Air Max 90 and Air Force One models, Jordan Brand is getting the Photon treatment, with the release of the Air Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Photon Dust.

The Air Jordan 4 SE Phototon Dust is constructed with leather and suede uppers consisting of various shades of grey. Jordan Brand is changing directions with the Air Jordan 4s mesh cage and replacing it with a soft suede and a cracked leather cage wing.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro SE Craft Photon Dust released February 11, 2023, with a retail price of $210.

name: CLOT Kiss of Death (2021)
title: Nike Air Max 1 CLOT Kiss of Death (2021)
description:
Nike and long-time collaborator, CLOT, reissued their Nike Air Max 1 CLOT Kiss Of Death in 2021. The sneaker debuted in 2006 and now the original pair is reselling for over $1,000 on StockX. Bringing back the collab in its original design answers the prayers of many Air Max fans that were unable to get their hands on the pair 15 years ago and in the years since.

For CLOT founder, Edison Chen, the sole mission of his work with Nike is to bridge Eastern and Western cultures through design and storytelling based on Chinese traditions. The Nike Air Max 1 CLOT Kiss Of Death fulfills this mission by mixing Nike’s innovative designs with Chinese philosophies on medicine, specifically foot pressure points. The upper is composed of translucent materials, making feet the focal point. Following the translucent theme, the shoe also features an icy-blue outsole with a printed diagram showing the pressure points on the foot. The shoe also incorporates some luxe details, such as faux snakeskin on the Swoosh and ostrich texture on the collar.

The Nike Air Max 1 CLOT Kiss Of Death released in March of 2021 for $150.

name: Dark Slate
title: adidas Yeezy 450 Dark Slate
description:
With a simplified two-piece construction, the adidas Yeezy 450 Dark Slate features Dark Slate foam sole that clasps a monochromatic sock-like Primeknit upper. From there, thick rope laces add the finishing touches.

The adidas Yeezy 450 Dark Slate released in June of 2021 and retailed for $200.

name: Alvah
title: adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Alvah
description:
This adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Alvah is composed of a black and grey upper composed of monofilament engineered mesh with RPU overlays for structure and durability. The RPU cage has glow-in-the-dark features, along with 3M reflective detailing on the toe. The EVA midsole and herringbone rubber outsole complete the design.

The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 Alvah released in February of 2020 and retailed for $200.

name: Undefeated Black Volt
title: Nike Air Max 97 Undefeated Black Volt
description:
The Nike Air Max 97 UNDFTD Black Volt is toned in three different colors: militia green, volt, as well as black.

The upper part of this Nike Air Max 97 is crafted from leather and mesh and has a black base. Its upper part also features accents of a militia green hue. The tongue pull-tab, as well as the tongue Swoosh branding on this sneaker, are both highlighted by a volt hue. There is a visible full-length Max Air unit on the midsole of this shoe that completes its design.

The Nike Air Max 97 UNDFTD Black Volt debuted on December 29, 2020, with a recommended retail price of $180.

name: A Ma Maniére (Women's)
title: Jordan 3 Retro SP A Ma Maniére (Women's)
description:
After a slew of collaborative releases with adidas and Nike, DC-based sneaker boutique A Ma Maniére teamed up with Jordan Brand to release a women’s exclusive Jordan 3 with the Air Jordan 3 A Ma Maniére (W). The release aligns with their short film Raised By Women, an ode to the strides and accomplishments of everyday women in urban communities.

The Air Jordan 3 A Ma Maniére arrives featuring a white tumbled leather upper with Medium Grey suede on the toe wrap, eyestay, heel wrap, and ankle. Each panel of leather on the upper has a raw trim, revealing a natural, tan edge. To provide a vintage aesthetic, the eyelets, heel tab, and lower portion of the midsole are yellowed. From there, the tongue on the left sneaker features an embroidered A Ma Maniére logo, while the right features a Jumpman logo. Quilted satin lining on the interior of the shoe adds an element of luxury. A white, Violet Ore, and Medium Grey sole with a classic Air unit in the heel completes this retro look.

The women's Air Jordan 3 A Ma Maniére released in April of 2021 and retailed for $200.
